summary: PUMA melanoma tissue-class contract with epidermis-specific semantics, separate nuclei annotations, primary/metastatic conditioning, and immutable white background.

annotation_traits: tissue and nuclei annotations are separate annotation layers
the canonical Normal epithelium label specifically means epidermis in this profile
ROIs include primary and metastatic melanoma and must be stratified by source
semantic_limitations: Normal epithelium means epidermis, not a generic normal epithelial compartment.
Immune cells are available in the nuclei layer but there is no immune tissue-region label in the profile.
Other tissue is not encoded; unmodeled tissue must not be invented from background.

rules.claim: Enforce the compiler-bound profile_required_provenance execution invariant.
rules.required_observation: Use only the typed observation_authority records; no unannotated histologic structure observation is authorized.
known_limitations: The current profile has no certified stratified statistics artifact.

rules.claim: Enforce the compiler-bound background_seed_protection execution invariant.
rules.required_observation: Use only the typed observation_authority records; no unannotated histologic structure observation is authorized.
known_limitations: Tears and processing clefts may look white on H&E; the mask contract remains pixel-preserving.

rules.claim: Interpret canonical Normal epithelium strictly as epidermis and preserve its layered continuity unless an epidermis-specific primitive is requested.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
exceptions: A reviewed epidermal invasion or ulceration primitive.
counterexamples: Treating epidermis as generic glandular normal epithelium.
Cutting an isolated notch into intact epidermis during dermal tumor growth.
expected_morphology: An intact, continuous epidermal band remains unchanged in a generic burden edit.
forbidden_morphology: Remote epidermal deletion, split, island, or false ulceration.
known_limitations: The tissue label alone does not encode epidermal layers or ulceration criteria.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.
